fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.0: Is that... a fairy? A real one? My grandmother swore they were only stories.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.1: I'd give a year's wages for what's in that bottle. Two years.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.2: Gods above, look at her glow. Keep her close, traveller. Folk would kill for less.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.3: They say a fairy keeps death off the one who carries her. Once. Only once.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.4: Where did you find her? No, don't tell me. I'd only go looking and break my neck.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.5: My mother saw one over the flowers when she was a girl, she said. Nobody believed her.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.6: If you ever tire of her, you bring her to me first. Promise me that.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.7: The old folk say they only come where the woods are quiet, on the darkest nights.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.child.0: A fairy! A fairy! Can I hold her? Please? Just for a moment?
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.child.1: She's so pink! Does she talk? What's her name?
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.child.2: I'm going to catch one too when I'm big. I'll be ever so quiet.
fairy.jaymoskingdoms.seen.child.3: Mama! Mama, come quick, the traveller has a fairy!
